title: HIGH-OCTANE CHARGE
subtitle: Art Deco energy for the wireless age.
body:
We’ve been quietly cooking up something special in the Gachafruit workshop: a fully in-house designed wireless charging station inspired by the golden age of American Art Deco and vintage gas pump styling.

Meet High-Octane Charge - a glowing desktop centerpiece designed to brighten up my office. 

Built from real wood and some of the finest textured terracotta PLA we’ve ever worked with, this piece blends warm industrial materials with soft neon lighting and streamlined 1930s-inspired geometry. The goal was to blend our love of Art Deco with a need for some crazy cool and totally functional decor.

And yes… our obsession with Art Deco absolutely comes from our years surrounded by beautiful antiques at Dickson Antiquities.

This prototype is currently about 80% complete, with more detailing, trim work, and finishing touches still on the way. But even in its current state, it already glows like a little roadside beacon from another era. If you find yourself wanting one of these bad boys before they've officially been listed, shoot us a message.

More updates soon. ⚡

images.alt: Gachafruit Studio phone charger in the shape of a vintage gas pump with LED globe.
